violation_type.title: Required Admission Information-Limitations or restrictions (26 TAC §744.605(13)(A))
violation_type.typical_finding: While reviewing children's records, a child did not have a "Special Care Statement" completed.

finding_variants.text: While reviewing children's records, a child did not have a "Special Care Statement" completed.
